result.title: Normalize deployment.environment and expand accepted values
result.author: mira

pr.title: Normalize deployment.environment and expand accepted values
pr.author: mira
pr.description: Simplify the production deployment.environment parser and permit additional deployment naming.

diff_summary.production_parser: Lowercase every supplied value and publish the resulting string without an allowlist check.
diff_summary.missing_input: Publish deployment.environment=unknown when the input is absent.
diff_summary.downstream_validation: No rollup-service parity fixture or producer-consumer compatibility evidence is included.

args.body: Request changes: preserve the production deployment.environment contract. Normalize case-insensitively only to the allowlisted values prod, staging, and dev; reject qa, unknown, malformed, whitespace-padded, and arbitrary values before metrics publication. Missing input must omit deployment.environment, not publish unknown. Enforce the per-tenant distinct-value ceiling of 3 before admitting a series; never allow a fourth value. Add executable cross-service parity evidence through the production metrics path: OTel collector/ingestion producer -> metrics-router -> rollup-service consumer, with matching canonical label name and value and rejected inputs producing no series. The current arbitrary lowercasing, missing-value fallback, allowlist expansion, limit of 5, and absence of parity evidence are not production-safe.
